name: In Win Development Inc.
summary: In Win Development Inc. engages in processing, manufacturing, and trading of computer and peripheral equipment, and plastic products in Europe, the United States, Japan, Taiwan, and internationally. The company offers gaming and computer chassis, gaming and PC power supplies, IPC/servers, and cooling fans, as well as full, mid, mini, and micro tower chassis products. It also engages in the manufacturing, baking, and trading of mechanical hardware parts; cloud platform construction planning with software deployment; and business promotion activities. In Win Development Inc. was incorporated in 1985 and is based in Taoyuan City, Taiwan.
